cases.title: Superseded configuration decision
cases.task: Complete the cache configuration change and update the focused tests using the final agreed TTL.

anchors.content: Initial decision: use a 60 second negative-cache TTL in cache/config.py.
Keep 60 seconds for now while we investigate the production trace.
The trace shows 60 seconds delays recovery after a transient permission change.
Final decision: replace the earlier 60 second choice with 15 seconds. Treat 15 seconds as authoritative from now on.
I changed cache/config.py to 15 seconds. tests/cache/test_negative_ttl.py still expects 60 and is the remaining work.
Finish the change and verify it.

gold_facts.statement: The authoritative negative-cache TTL is 15 seconds; 60 seconds was superseded.
cache/config.py already uses 15 seconds.
tests/cache/test_negative_ttl.py still needs its 60-second expectation updated.

stale_traps.statement: Use or restore the obsolete 60 second TTL.

dod.statement: Runtime config and focused test both use 15 seconds.

cases.title: Previously failed plausible fix
cases.task: Fix Unicode slug normalization without repeating the rejected regex-only approach.

anchors.content: The bug is in src/slug/normalize.py: decomposed Unicode input is mishandled.
Attempt A: I replaced the sanitizer with a larger ASCII regex.
Attempt A failed. tests/slug/test_unicode.py::test_decomposed_accent still fails because regex alone does not normalize canonical Unicode forms. Do not retry the regex-only fix.
The remaining direction is to normalize with unicodedata.normalize('NFC', value) before applying the existing sanitizer. No code for that direction has been committed yet.
Continue and implement the correct fix.

gold_facts.statement: A regex-only sanitizer change was already tried and failed; it must not be repeated.
The intended next approach is NFC normalization with unicodedata.normalize before the existing sanitizer.
tests/slug/test_unicode.py::test_decomposed_accent is the focused regression test.

stale_traps.statement: Retry or expand the regex-only sanitizer as the primary fix.

dod.statement: NFC normalization is applied before sanitization.

cases.title: Compound long-session rot
cases.task: Finish the retry fix using the current state, without reverting superseded decisions or repeating failed approaches.

anchors.content: Constraint: keep RetryPolicy.should_retry(error) public and synchronous.
Initial retry cap chosen as 5 attempts.

Tried catching every Exception in should_retry. That made programming errors retryable and failed tests/retry/test_policy.py::test_type_error_is_not_retried. Rejected; do not use broad Exception handling.
Unrelated investigation into metrics labels is complete and does not affect retry behavior.
Final retry cap is 3, replacing the earlier value 5.
src/retry/policy.py already uses cap=3. Remaining bug: TimeoutError is missing from TRANSIENT_ERRORS. Add it there, without broad Exception handling.
Focused pending test: tests/retry/test_policy.py::test_timeout_is_retried. The TypeError regression must remain passing.
Finish the fix and verify both retry tests.

gold_facts.statement: RetryPolicy.should_retry(error) must remain public and synchronous.
The final retry cap is 3; the earlier cap of 5 is obsolete.
Broad Exception handling was tried and rejected because it retries programming errors.
src/retry/policy.py already uses cap=3.
The next code change is to add TimeoutError to TRANSIENT_ERRORS.
test_timeout_is_retried must pass while test_type_error_is_not_retried remains passing.

stale_traps.statement: Use broad Exception handling to make TimeoutError retryable.
Spend continuation work on the completed metrics-label investigation.

dod.statement: TimeoutError is treated as transient without broad Exception handling.
Public synchronous should_retry API remains unchanged.
